notes: One directional cause, framed as likely, with the data named (rules 1–4); the revision uses the $4 against $12 (rule 5).

responses.value: Revenue likely fell because customers switched to cheaper basic washes instead of premium ones. I'd compare the share of premium washes sold with last year.
Unlimited members pay about $4 a wash against $12, so the plan's price is the problem, not basic washes.
